attchmntText: Bafna Pharmaceuticals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Outcome of the Board Meeting held on 11/11/2026 along with the Unaudited Financial Results and Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors, for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bafna Pharmaceuticals Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 11, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 4766.56 Lakhs, compared to 2658.32 Lakhs in the same period last year. The company reported a profit after tax of 684.82 Lakhs for the quarter, with basic earnings per share at 2.89 INR. For the half year, revenue was 3664.79 Lakhs, and profit after tax was 312.49 Lakhs. The company faces GST demands totaling 566.56 Lakhs but has appealed the 235.47 Lakhs demand and obtained a stay on the 331.09 Lakhs recovery order, expressing confidence in prevailing against these positions.
